lines.t: Six Keynotes! I'd applaud, but my mittens muffle it. Consider yourself applauded.
Welcome to Rime Hall. Mind your breath — it freezes, and Cantor Isaure collects the good ones.
Two rime panels seal the hall. Out-sing a hall Tuner and their panel melts away.
Isaure's kin are frost, and so is the hall. Fire, stone and steady nerves fare well. No fire voice? There's a thaw lever.
Before you go — this Etude. Rime Beam. A patient light that waits for its moment, then freezes it.
The hall rang on its own this morning. Every icicle, one chord. I sat down on the floor and listened until my tea froze.
Odile climbed past my door at dawn with a bell on a sledge. I offered tea. She declined, politely. That worried me most.
The summit path is north of the terraces. Go slowly. Cold is patient, and so is whatever waits at the top.
Cold is patience made visible. Let's see how patient you are.
Unhurried and unbroken. The mountain approves.
The last Keynote, tuned to light. Six notes. Go and make them a chord.
And this Etude — Rime Beam. A patient light that waits for its moment, then freezes it.
My panel melted the moment you won. Took me three weeks to grow that panel. Worth it.
Isaure doesn't hurry. Don't you hurry either. That's the whole trick, really.
Cold is patience made visible. Let's see how patient you are.
Unhurried and unbroken. The mountain approves.
Impatience cracks first. Breathe, then return.
The last Keynote, tuned to light. Six notes. Go and make them a chord.
